instruction: Look at freecad_task-20_input.step in FreeCAD. Machine the block into a sliding carriage with underside and top rail details. Keep the original 150 x 80 x 35 mm block coordinate frame. Cut an underside U-channel 110 x 42 x 22 mm, centered at X=75 and Y=40, opening through the bottom and leaving 20 mm end walls. Cut a top T-slot along X: a narrow upper slot 130 x 14 mm from Z=23 to Z=35 and a wider lower slot 130 x 28 mm from Z=17 to Z=25, both centered at Y=40. Add two raised top rails, each 130 x 8 x 8 mm, running along X on both sides of the T-slot with bottoms at Z=35. Cut four horizontal side cross-holes of diameter 7 mm through the carriage along Y, centered at X=25,55,95,125 mm and Z=10 mm. Cut two vertical obround mounting slots centered at (40,40) and (110,40), length 34 mm along Y and width 9 mm. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-20_output.step using GUI operations only; external script files are forbidden.
